[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 400 people sickened in ongoing salmonella outbreak linked to fresh jalapeños
item.description: Over 400 people in 32 states have been sickened with salmonella tied to an outbreak in fresh jalapeños, according to the latest update from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Airplane pilot killed in collision with Pennsylvania police helicopter near runway
item.description: An airplane pilot died after a violent collision with a Pennsylvania State Police helicopter near a runway at a small airport, but both state troopers aboard the helicopter survived, authorities said.

item.description: A Citrus County Sheriff’s Office (CCSO) deputy was fired on Thursday after he was arrested for battering a Target store employee, officials said.
